guarantee: B current-actor normal HTTP observation; verified_business=false. No A transactional receipt claim.

python.sql_contract_test_limitation: test_manage_postgres_writes is a SQL contract fixture, not native PostgreSQL.

native_postgres.cluster: Explicit isolated loopback fixture, port 55439; newly created random synthetic database dropped by tearDownClass
evidence: Actual pg_locks proves course template replacement waits for the shared course lock
A new learning progress FK insert waits for the session FOR UPDATE guard
Actual cancellation SQL keeps generation results, learning records and material bindings; rollback restores snapshot
native_postgres.limitation: Shared lock, snapshot and domain SQL proof. Full HTTP policy/save CAS uses the separate SQLite suite.

browser.fixture: Real offering form fragment and built tailwind-app.css; actual manage_offerings.js and api.js, mocked HTTP responses, no server/DB
evidence: Reviewed revision submitted with form; failed save preserves inputs and permits retry
409 requires a refreshed displayed preview and another user action
Late responses cannot replace newer form/accepted revision
Historical-content blockers visible and no automatic write
Repeated submit is disabled until the actual request settles

authority.ordinary_student_status: Server-owned class permission checked before and after task/actor locks; monotonic revision; suspended or changed state revokes task/persistent grants and sessions in one transaction; activation never revives grants
authority.academic_batch: Only affected incoming current-owner students; task queries in chunks of 400, all task IDs locked in ascending order before sorted actor mutexes; no per-school scan; after-wait state requires prepared actor or rolls back with 409
authority.independent_native_credential_recheck: Parent permissions agent reran five actual PostgreSQL credential issuance/revocation races after helper extraction; all passed.

plan_edit.snapshot: Desired schedule and source course/class/semester/textbook plus existing offering, every session, linked classes, material binding rows and protected session IDs
plan_edit.locks: Course IDs ascending, then target offering, then session IDs ascending; actual FK insert blocked until guard transaction ends
plan_edit.history: Removed sessions marked canceled, never deleted by existing editor. Dates can be corrected with stable IDs. Protected content and main material cannot be silently repurposed. Class composition/course/semester changes with existing sessions require separate lifecycle workflow; changing primary class within unchanged membership remains allowed.
plan_edit.legacy: Primary-only installations do not create optional material-binding tables during preview. Existing Web editor now submits required preview revision.
plan_edit.performance: Preview/save SQL runs in threadpool; same ASGI-loop ping remains responsive during a simulated waiting DB lock.

not_covered: Course/class/classroom deletion and merge execution confirmation
Student account move across existing classes outside the ordinary reviewed roster workflow
Production migration/deployment or real DSH task acceptance
isolation: Teaching HTTP connectors are restricted to one per-test temporary SQLite file or :memory:; imported DB aliases patched and unexpected connectors rejected. Native PostgreSQL uses connect_offline target validation and exclusive random fixture DB creation.
